text_block_list.text:
I did it...! I won!
I really took 1st place...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I feel like this is another
step forward for me!

text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just my own strength.
It's all thanks to your support, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"When two walk together, there are four footprints!"
I look forward to your continued guidance and support!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! To put it as a proverb,
"Victory won, racewear cleaned!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The others have been putting in countless hours of hard work too,
so I won't let my guard down!
